questions.q: P is any point inside the rectangle ABCD. If PA = 98 cm, PB = 91 cm and PC = 21 cm, then the length of PD (in cm) is equal to:
questions.explain: For any point P inside a rectangle ABCD, the sum of the squares of distances to opposite vertices are equal: $PA^2 + PC^2 = PB^2 + PD^2$. Substituting the given values: $98^2 + 21^2 = 91^2 + PD^2 \Rightarrow 9604 + 441 = 8281 + PD^2 \Rightarrow 10045 = 8281 + PD^2 \Rightarrow PD^2 = 1764$. Taking the square root gives $PD = 42\text{ cm}$.
